label: PF Backlog 451
title: DEFECT: /wg CLI ignores WORKERGRID_HOME + local claim never unwraps the PF envelope
body:
Source: found while answering "can we run /wg from any session / register / take work" (2026-10-07),
by exercising the /wg CLI live against a coordinator on a non-default port.

DEFECT 1 - the Python CLI ignores WORKERGRID_HOME (config-resolution divergence).
`workergrid/_cfg.py:5-13` computes `ROOT = dirname(_cfg.py)` and `load()` always reads
`<workergrid>/config.json`; only `state_dir()` honours `WORKERGRID_STATE_DIR`. The Go coordinator/agent
(`internal/config.Home()`) DO honour `WORKERGRID_HOME` (documented in workergrid/README.md). So `/wg serve`
and `/wg status|register|work|dispatch` can resolve DIFFERENT service_url/pf_api_url -> the CLI silently falls
back to "local" mode (observed: `service_url()` returned the default 8790 while the coordinator ran on 8892).

DEFECT 2 - local-mode claim never unwraps the producer envelope.
`workergrid/wg.py` `cmd_work` local branch reads `data.get("found")` / `data.get("item")` on the PF envelope
`{request_id,status,data:{found,item,...}}`, so the top level has no `found`/`item` and the claim ALWAYS returns
"no eligible item" even when work is eligible. This is the same envelope defect the coordinator had (RCCA on
BI-PF-0412); the Python local path was never fixed.

Impact: `/wg register|work|dispatch` are unreliable outside the default single-checkout setup, and the
single-machine (no-coordinator) claim path is broken. The Go paths (serve/agent, and coordinator POST /work)
are correct and were proven live.

Fix (small): (1) `_cfg.load()` honours `WORKERGRID_HOME` (mirror Go: WORKERGRID_HOME > walk up from the script
dir); (2) `cmd_work` local branch unwraps one envelope level before reading found/item. Tests: `_cfg` honours
WORKERGRID_HOME; local-mode work with a stub producer serving the canonical envelope returns the item.

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false - WorkerGrid CLI correctness; no UI surface.
